title: Foundations in Geography
description: Examines key themes, concepts, theories, debates, and histories of geography from an integrative perspective, as well as professional development skills for careers in geography. Highlights the breadth and diversity of approaches to geographical research and professional practice. Students participate in weekly seminar discussions and develop research skills needed to critically analyze and contribute to contemporary geographical research.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GEOG 500A, GEOG 500.
